formulas.name: Wind power
notes: Where: ρ ≈ 1.225 kg/m³, v = wind speed, C<sub>p</sub> = power coefficient
Tip: Power ∝ v³: double the wind speed → 8× power.

formulas.name: Betz limit
notes: Where: C<sub>p</sub> = power coefficient = rotor power ÷ power in the wind
Tip: No turbine can extract more than 59.3% of wind power; practical 0.35–0.45.

formulas.name: Tip-speed ratio
notes: Where: ω = rotor speed (rad/s), R = blade radius (m), v = wind speed (m/s)
Tip: Optimum λ ≈ 6–8 for 3-blade HAWT; C<sub>p</sub> peaks at optimum λ.

formulas.name: Wind MPPT
f: Keep λ at optimum : T<sub>opt</sub> = K<sub>opt</sub>ω<sup>2</sup> or hill −climb search
notes: Where: λ = tip-speed ratio, ω = rotor speed (rad/s), K<sub>opt</sub> = constant for the turbine
Tip: Cut-in ≈ 3–4 m/s, rated ≈ 12–15 m/s, cut-out ≈ 25 m/s.

formulas.name: Micro-hydro
notes: Where: η = overall efficiency, Q = flow (m³/s), H = head (m); P in kW
Tip: India: micro < 100 kW, mini 100 kW–2 MW, small < 25 MW. Pelton/Turgo (high head), cross-flow, Francis.
